analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price($57.56) vs SMA5/20/50($56.60/$55.52/$55.87): Short-to-mid term trend above moving averages.
· Position relative to SMA100/200($55.82/$53.43): Indicates strong mid-to-long term uptrend.
· 52-week position (90.5%) + Current price level approaching historical highs.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (56.3→65.3) + Classified as exiting oversold and entering neutral zone + Bullish momentum.
· MACD histogram trajectory (0.2659→0.2516) + Classified as bullish continuation + No trend reversal signal.
· Bollinger Band current price position (near upper band $57.48) + Bandwidth at 7.08% indicates expansion.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support ($56.91) + Based on previous 5-day high breakout level.
· Swing resistance ($58.41) + Breakout could lead to new 52-week high.
· 5-day/20-day high/low pattern (Higher Low) + Indicates recovery trend.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (1.41x) + Suggests increased conviction in the move.
· Current phase diagnosis (Uptrend) + Buying entry condition met with 5 consecutive days of new highs.
